entries.claim: Absa Group Limited is listed on the JSE under ticker ABG.
entries.source_ref: JSE listing / Absa Group annual report

entries.claim: Renamed from Barclays Africa Group to Absa Group in 2018; Barclays wound down its controlling stake.
entries.source_ref: Absa Group public announcements and filings

entries.claim: Core processing spans SAP and Finacle (heterogeneous/dual estate).
entries.source_ref: Company/vendor reporting on Absa core banking

entries.claim: AWS-led cloud migration following the Barclays separation.
Consumer surfaces: Absa Banking App, Absa Pay and WhatsApp ChatBanking.
entries.source_ref: Public app-store listing for Absa Banking App; Absa ChatBanking announcements

entries.claim: Retail product ladder: Transact, Flexi Core, Ultimate, Wealth, plus Islamic Banking.
Absa Rewards delivers cashback and tiered grocery/fuel rebates with Sasol as fuel partner.
Regulated by the SARB Prudential Authority under the Banks Act 94 of 1990.
entries.source_ref: SARB Prudential Authority register; Absa Group annual report

entries.claim: Return on equity ~14-15.5% with a target of ~15-16% by FY2026; cost-to-income ~53-56%.
entries.source_ref: Absa Group results presentations (fiscal year ends 31 December)

entries.claim: App framework, certificate pinning, and the Absa Rewards rebate/tier formula are unresolved.
